headline: Twenty degrees as the light thins.
body: The hour holds at twenty degrees under a mostly cloudy cover. Southwest wind runs near seventeen kilometres an hour, pressure steady near one thousand nineteen as it falls. Dry paving and continuous traffic; lamps remain dark while the afternoon light begins to withdraw.

pulses.label: Sky
pulses.value: mostly cloudy, 20°C, SW 17 km/h, 1019 hPa falling

pulses.label: Light
pulses.value: afternoon light thinning; lamps still dark
